in_marathi.name: Jagpati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagpati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagpati is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Hindu mythology, Jagpati is believed to be the divine mother who nurtures and protects the earth. She is also known as Bhagavati, the goddess of wealth, fertility, and prosperity. This name signifies strength, stability, and the power of creation.
